tools.name: adminpulse_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the AdminPulse user that the API key belongs to (name and email). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /users/me.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (administrations) that this key can access, with their ids. GET /companies.

tools.name: adminpulse_search_relations
tools.description: List relations (clients, suppliers and contacts) with paging. Filter by text, relation type (0 company, 1 sole proprietor, 2 person), tags, or include inactive. GET /relations.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_relation
tools.description: Get one relation with its details. Pass the relation GUID or its unique identifier such as APR00001. GET /relations/{identifier}.

tools.name: adminpulse_find_relations_by_name
tools.description: Quick lookup of relations by name, returning a short list with their ids and unique identifiers. GET /relations/names.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with paging. Filter by relation, invoice date range, or sent, paid, exported and draft status. GET /invoices.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its id (GUID), with its lines and payment status. GET /invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with paging. Filter by relation id, deadline range, or main task template. GET /tasks.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by its id (GUID), with its status, deadline and relation. GET /tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: adminpulse_create_task
tools.description: Create a task for a relation. The deadline is ISO, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00. Status is the number the API defines. POST /tasks.

tools.name: adminpulse_update_task_status
tools.description: Set the status of a task found by relation, deadline and task names (no task id needed). Setting the same status again changes nothing. POST /tasks/updateStatus.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_interactions
tools.description: List logged interactions (calls, meetings, notes) with paging. Filter by relation, type or date. GET /interactions.

tools.name: adminpulse_add_interaction
tools.description: Log an interaction (for example a call or a note) on a relation. The date is ddMMyyyy and the time is HH:mm. POST /interactions/add.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_registrations
tools.description: List time or cost registrations with paging. Filter by relation, invoiced state or registration date range. GET /registrations.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_documents
tools.description: List document metadata (name, type, dates, tags) with paging. Filter by relation or document date range. GET /documents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: adminpulse_get_current_user · Private data: adminpulse_get_current_user, adminpulse_search_relations, adminpulse_list_documents · Public sink: adminpulse_get_current_user, adminpulse_create_task, adminpulse_update_task_status, adminpulse_add_interaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: adminpulse_get_current_user · Private data: adminpulse_get_current_user, adminpulse_search_relations, adminpulse_list_documents · Public sink: adminpulse_get_current_user, adminpulse_create_task, adminpulse_update_task_status, adminpulse_add_interaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
